title: Lincity
tagline: Build a city or a country, feed it and power it, then make it last or launch its people into space.
summary: Lincity is a city and country simulation from 1995. You lay out farms, homes, markets and tracks, then mines, mills and power stations; the people need food, jobs and goods, and the transport carries everything between them. Technology grows with schools and universities and unlocks railways, steel works, coal and solar power and finally rocket pads.

Every resource is finite: coal and ore run out, waste piles up and pollution spreads with the wind. You can build a sustainable economy with renewable power and recycling, or go for broke and evacuate a ruined planet by rocket.

This port follows Lincity 1.13.1 for X11, the last release of the classic game, with its screens, help pages, built-in scenarios and save files. Your saved scenes and your preferences are kept in your account.

original.author: I J Peters; Greg Sharp, Corey Keasling and others
